summary: Added retries (4 attempts, 1/2/4s waits or Retry-After via transport.sleep) and derived Idempotency-Keys (pl-<op>-<sha256[:24]>) for transfers, refunds and holds in books/penwick.py, with the reversal check-then-resend flow; captures and GETs carry no key. Verified with the existing unit test and an ad-hoc scenario script; not tested against a real Penwick-like server.
